Class CardCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.tui.CardCatalog
public final class CardCatalog extends Object
Utility class for resolving card IDs to display information. Card IDs encode their type via prefix (e.g., "hunter_01", "shamanic_ritual_02"). This class provides type inference from IDs and display helpers used when the full card catalog is not loaded from JSON.

  • Method Details

    • typeFromId

      public static CardType typeFromId(String id)
      Infers the CardType from a card ID based on its prefix.
      Parameters:
      id - the card ID (e.g. "hunter_01"), may be null
      Returns:
      the inferred card type, CardType.BUILDINGS as the default for unrecognized prefixes, or null if id is null

    • typeLabel

      public static String typeLabel(CardType type)
      Short display label for a card type (fits in an 8-char card slot).
      Parameters:
      type - the card type, may be null
      Returns:
      a short label, or "UNKNOWN" if type is null

    • isEvent

      public static boolean isEvent(CardType type)
      Parameters:
      type - the card type, may be null
      Returns:
      true if type is one of the event card types (hunt, sustenance, shamanic ritual, cave paintings)

    • isCharacter

      public static boolean isCharacter(CardType type)
      Parameters:
      type - the card type, may be null
      Returns:
      true if type is a character card, i.e. neither an event card (see isEvent(CardType)) nor CardType.BUILDINGS

    • typeSymbol

      public static String typeSymbol(CardType type)
      Single-character symbol for a card type, used in compact tribe display.
      Parameters:
      type - the card type, may be null
      Returns:
      a one-character symbol, "?" if type is null, or null for event card types (which have no symbol)
